title: The Modest Ones
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: They are mentioned in [Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Maaser_Sheni.5.1): “And the modest ones would set down the money.”
In [Yoma 39a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.39a.17): “And the modest ones would withdraw their hands.”
In [Demai 6:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Demai.6.6): “The modest ones of Beit Hillel used to act according to Beit Shammai.”
We likewise find Rabbi Shimon the Modest; see his entry.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Yoma reads מושכין (“withdraw”), beside Hyman’s מושבין. The linked Mishnah Demai names Beit Hillel, where the supplied Hebrew has ב״מ. [Heilprin’s Shimon the Modest](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3422&lang=en) is a separate named notice.
